**PART 1 - SHADOWING PRACTICE (2 minutes)**
**Voice:** Daniel
**Speed:** 0.70x (slow for practice)
**Format:** Say sentence → Pause 3 seconds → Repeat

**Practice Sentences (5-7 sentences with natural flow):**

1. Diego stepped off the plane and looked around the busy airport.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]

2. He held $20 in his pocket and could not speak English, and he felt scared and alone.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]

3. Diego worked twelve hours every day, and he saved every dollar he earned, and he lived on only $3 a day.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]

4. Every Sunday, Diego and Elena pooled their money together, and they went to an all-you-can-eat restaurant as their weekly treat.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]

5. After five years of hard work, Diego owned three restaurants, and he became a millionaire, and he felt successful and proud.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]

6. But one day, everything changed in an instant, and Diego received a phone call late at night.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]

7. The fire destroyed everything he had built, and Diego lost his restaurants and all his money, and he felt helpless and lost.
   [PAUSE 3 SECONDS]
